task: Atlas path classification: resolve otherwise-unowned shopper-facing app pages and storefront metadata without overriding specific domain authorities.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: PR #666 plan-only replay after planned-deletion authorization still cannot project DOMAIN-STOREFRONT for src/app/oldal/[slug]/page.tsx and src/app/sitemap.ts because canonical domain matching returns no owner before the planned domain-registry edit exists. Plan-before-code therefore deadlocks on an authority change it is supposed to authorize.
observableOutcomes: An otherwise-unowned src/app/**/page.tsx path resolves to DOMAIN-STOREFRONT/shared-storefront.
An otherwise-unowned src/app/sitemap.ts storefront metadata path resolves to DOMAIN-STOREFRONT/shared-storefront.
Existing explicit DOMAIN-ADMIN, DOMAIN-BUILDER, DOMAIN-IDENTITY, API and other canonical domain matches remain authoritative and are never replaced by the fallback.
PR #666 planned projection can resolve src/app/oldal/[slug]/page.tsx and src/app/sitemap.ts before implementation.
unresolvedRisks: A broad fallback could incorrectly steal explicitly-owned admin/builder routes.
API route handlers must not be classified as storefront presentation merely because they live under src/app.
Fallback must remain path-derived classification, not an exception tied to PR #666 file names.

in: Existing Codebase Atlas classifyAtlasPath fallback semantics.
Shopper-facing app page and sitemap metadata paths with no stronger canonical domain match.
Adversarial regression tests proving explicit domain ownership wins.
out: Domain registry rewrite or a second authority system.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: A foundational pre-execution authority classifier must resolve public presentation surfaces deterministically while preserving specific authority precedence; negative controls are required before replaying #666.

acceptanceCriteria: For an otherwise-unowned shopper-facing dynamic page such as src/app/oldal/[slug]/page.tsx, classifyAtlasPath must return DOMAIN-STOREFRONT/shared-storefront and a page route while preserving the absence of any business-truth ownership.

For src/app/sitemap.ts with no stronger canonical domain match, classifyAtlasPath must return DOMAIN-STOREFRONT/shared-storefront so public navigation metadata has deterministic presentation authority.
For src/app/admin/orders/page.tsx with an explicit DOMAIN-ADMIN match, classifyAtlasPath must return DOMAIN-ADMIN/admin-operations without adding DOMAIN-STOREFRONT.
For src/app/storefront-template-preview/page.tsx with an explicit DOMAIN-BUILDER match, classifyAtlasPath must retain DOMAIN-BUILDER/builder-template-system without storefront fallback.
For src/app/api/orders/route.ts, storefront presentation fallback must not apply and the existing explicit API/business authority remains unchanged.
invariants: Explicit canonical domain matches always take precedence over storefront fallback.
Fallback applies only when classifyDomains(file) is empty.
Fallback is presentation-only and does not grant commerce/catalog/data truth ownership.
No PR-number or shipping/payment-specific file exception is introduced.

failureModes: Unowned public page blocks Plan Before Code.
Fallback steals a more specific authority.
edgeCases: Admin page with explicit DOMAIN-ADMIN match.
Builder preview page with explicit DOMAIN-BUILDER match.

alternatives.summary: Apply storefront presentation fallback only when no canonical domain matches.
alternatives.reason: Resolves unowned public presentation paths while preserving explicit authority precedence.
Pattern specificity could outrank or interfere with explicit admin/builder ownership.

alternatives.summary: Special-case oldal/[slug] and sitemap in Plan Gate.
alternatives.reason: Would encode product-specific exceptions into foundational classification.

specialistReviews.finding: Fallback must run only after canonical domain matching returns empty.
specialistReviews.resolution: Preserve classifyDomains precedence; add storefront presentation fallback afterward.

specialistReviews.finding: Generic src/app ownership can collide with admin/builder domains.
specialistReviews.resolution: Negative controls prove existing explicit matches remain unchanged.

specialistReviews.finding: Next metadata files are not routeForFile pages but still public storefront presentation composition.
specialistReviews.resolution: Handle sitemap metadata as a narrow presentation fallback; do not include route.ts/API handlers.

specialistReviews.finding: Fix must not become a PR #666 path list.
specialistReviews.resolution: Tests target generic precedence rules and representative public/admin/builder/API paths.

challenge.scenario: Dynamic shopper page has no canonical domain path.
challenge.resolution: Fallback to DOMAIN-STOREFRONT only when canonical match set is empty.

challenge.scenario: Admin page also matches generic app-page shape.
challenge.resolution: Do not execute fallback when DOMAIN-ADMIN already matches.

challenge.scenario: Builder preview page is under src/app.
challenge.finding: Storefront fallback could steal builder authority.
challenge.resolution: Existing DOMAIN-BUILDER canonical match wins before fallback.

challenge.scenario: API route handler lives under src/app/api.
challenge.resolution: Fallback recognizes page.tsx/jsx presentation files, never route.ts handlers.

challenge.finding: It remains unowned despite composing public storefront navigation.

challenge.scenario: A commerce or auth page imports business truth.
challenge.finding: Presentation ownership must not imply business truth ownership.
challenge.resolution: Fallback adds only DOMAIN-STOREFRONT; dependency closure remains separate.

challenge.scenario: Canonical registry later adds an exact path.
challenge.finding: Fallback could conflict with new authority.
challenge.resolution: Canonical match automatically takes precedence and suppresses fallback.

challenge.scenario: PR #666 replays with planned domain-foundation edits still absent.
challenge.finding: Plan must resolve current public paths pre-code.
challenge.resolution: Generic path fallback provides pre-execution architecture ownership independent of future registry edits.

proofPlan: Plan-only Plan Before Code PASS before implementation.
Document storefront fallback precedence in the existing DOMAIN-STOREFRONT boundary rules.
Implement fallback only after canonical domain matching returns empty.
Unit-test generic public page and sitemap fallback plus admin/builder/API negative controls.
Run exact-head Edit-Time, Incremental Replay, Quality, TypeScript, Production Build and Truth; CLOSE→LEARN before merge.
After merge replay #666 plan-only without changing product intent.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Admin/builder/API explicit ownership must not be replaced by storefront fallback.
